findings.F1: The effect lies wholly in 2018. In 2018 the mean unusual 96-hour short move is +2.13 % (t 3.24, 376 cases), and five of six coins show it there (BTC t 2.38, ETH 2.47, XMR 2.04, LTC 1.33, ZEC 1.50; XRP -0.09). Without 2018 it is -0.05 % (t -0.24, 1,898 cases), and from 2019 to 2025 every year lies between -0.54 % and +0.93 % with |t| below 1.9.
findings.F2: The grading runs against the idea, on both of its gradings. Regressing the unusual move on the 30-day return gives a positive slope (0.0295, t 1.74, n 1,615; 0.0363, t 1.83 without 2018): a deeper fall is followed by a smaller further decline. The deepest 30-day-fall quartile (-65 % to -23 %) shows -0.67 % (t -1.23), against +1.13 % (t 2.64) and +0.98 % (t 2.52) in the two middle quartiles. The largest plunges (forecast at -20, 253 cases) show +0.06 % (t 0.09), while the smallest (forecast between -5 and 0, 1,372 cases) carry the pooled result at +0.59 % (t 2.30).
findings.F3: A longer horizon does not change the picture. Pooled, the unusual move grows from +0.31 % at 96 hours (t 1.57, 2,274 cases) to +0.75 % at 192 hours (t 2.74). Without 2018 it is still -0.03 % at 192 hours (t -0.09).
findings.F4: The effect is not spread across coins. Only 52 % of coin-windows have a positive mean. BTC (+0.67 %, t 1.84) and ETH (+0.74 %, t 1.57) lead, while LTC, XMR and XRP are at zero (|t| below 0.1).
findings.F5: A short book here cannot pay. The coin's normal drift works against the short at -0.51 % per case, so the total move per case is -0.20 % (-1.1 times the 0.19 % cost of a trade), and the book's Sharpe is -0.31. Even the unusual move alone, +0.31 %, is only 1.6 times the cost and has a strength of 0.036. That is below the roughly 0.05 of real ideas (findings F10 and F11).

ideas.name: plunge continuation, more coins
ideas.idea: When a coin's 24-hour return, read at an hourly close, falls by a large multiple of its 30-day average absolute daily return while its 30-day return is negative, the price falls further over the next 4 days by more than the coin's usual 4-day drift, and the deeper the 30-day fall, the larger the further decline.
ideas.consequence: A sharp hourly plunge in a coin that has fallen over the past month is a reason not to buy the dip, and a reason to short it for four days.
